about_pullquote: A well-painted room speaks volumes. We take the time to get it right.
about_para_1: Solihull Decorators was founded on a simple belief: good decorating transforms a space, and good decorators listen to their customers. Over 15 years, we've built a reputation for honest pricing, meticulous preparation, and finishes that last. Every job, from a single bedroom to a full house exterior, gets the same level of care and attention.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we turn up on time, protect their homes while we work, and leave no mess behind. We specialise in helping homeowners and small businesses refresh their spaces without the stress or surprise costs that often come with tradespeople.

reviews.text: Had the whole house redecorated — lounge, bedrooms, hallway, the lot. They were punctual, careful with our furniture, and the finish is brilliant. No paint splashes, no drama. Best decision we made. Will definitely book them again.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Bit nervous about having someone in to do the exterior, but the team was professional from start to finish. They prepped the woodwork properly, chose exactly the right colours for our period home, and the paint job looks factory-fresh. Really pleased.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: We run a small office in Birmingham and needed a quick refresh during a weekend. They came in, did the lot to schedule, and we opened Monday morning with freshly painted walls and trim. Efficient, tidy, and reasonably priced. Would use again.
reviews.author: Emma C.
